title: WordPress Fuel
pitch: Guide your local AI agent through connecting an existing WordPress website, downloading its source and establishing a documented development workflow.

flow.d: Inspect your project and reuse existing setup.
Verify SSH and the exact WordPress site.
Download selected source and document the website.
Establish Git, publishing and recovery; then make a checked change.

items.role: Agent entry point and workflow boundaries.

items: Requires an authorized local agent and suitable hosting access.
No default production database download or generic deployment shortcut.
Site-specific analysis and checked recovery remain necessary.
